x-agent-definitions.name: Master Orchestrator
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Workflow, dependencies, task delegation, budgets and escalation.

x-agent-definitions.name: Research & Fact Agent
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Topics, source discovery, evidence and claim verification.

x-agent-definitions.name: Media Discovery Agent
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Federated image/video search, rights checks, dedup and asset selection.

x-agent-definitions.name: Creative Director
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Theme, genre, narrative style, visual language and creative brief.

x-agent-definitions.name: Scriptwriter & Reasoner
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Hook, story beats, screenplay, dialogue and pacing.

x-agent-definitions.name: Scene Director
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Scene decomposition, storyboards, shots, cinematography and prompt compilation.

x-agent-definitions.name: Visual Production Agent
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Image/video provider routing, generation, reuse and shot repairs.

x-agent-definitions.name: Audio & Performance Agent
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Voice, multilingual speech, music, Foley, lip-sync and gestures.

x-agent-definitions.name: Editor & QC Agent
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Timeline assembly, compositing, grading and technical/creative review.

x-agent-definitions.name: Cost & Optimization Agent
x-agent-definitions.responsibility: Quotes, routing advice, budgets, caching and spend reports.
